last_change.summary: Added bounded named version predicates and software requirement refinements in embedded contracts for issue #1205. Restrict refinement purposes to their component, repository or trust identity owner. Preserve governed private runtime identities and finite operation vocabularies from issue #1206. Allow partial runtime inventory descriptions and preserve unknown database protocol defaults without weakening selected-operation admission (#1207). Extend containing artifact, service, identity and access selections with the common typed profile contract and resource kinds with pinned coordinates; retain built-in controls and conditional AD names for issue #1208.
